areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Credit line for industrial decarbonization and greenhouse-gas reduction investments.

areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy
areas.reason: Credit line for renewable-grid integration, industrial eco-efficiency and renewable generation including green hydrogen and biomethane.

areas.name: Business environment and opportunities
areas.reason: Creates credit lines financing low-carbon industry, energy transition and related support infrastructure.

areas.name: Financing arrangements encouraging private participation
areas.reason: Programme seeks to leverage private investment in low-carbon industrial and energy value chains.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Support infrastructure may include water and sewage works, but the programme has no actions directly on sanitation.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Sustainable water-use initiatives are only possible support works; no actions directly on water security.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: Recovery of impacted water sources is only a possible support work; no actions directly on biodiversity or forests.

areas.name: Individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms
areas.reason: Small firms involved only through value chains; no actions directly benefiting them.

areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: New jobs mentioned only indirectly; no actions directly on employment and income generation.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Support infrastructure may affect low-income areas, but no actions directly targeted at vulnerable populations.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: No actions directly aimed at including social minorities.

areas.name: Youth, gender and race policies
areas.reason: No actions directly related to youth, gender or race policies.

areas.name: Public-service delivery, management and citizen participation
